settings.q: Can you build a model of our specific plant?
settings.a: Yes. Send your plant design, layout drawings or CAD and we'll build an accurate scale model of your facility.

settings.q: Can it include moving or lit elements?
settings.a: Yes - LED lighting, labelled zones and selected moving/demo elements can be built in. Tell us what you want to show.

settings.q: Does it come with a protective case?
settings.a: Yes, a clear case and presentation base are included to protect it for repeated use.
Yes, we ship worldwide from Dubai, crated to protect the model and case.

settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale model of a biogas plant - rows of digester tanks, pipework and access structures reproduced to scale on a clean base under a protective case. Built to explain a complex process plant to investors, visitors and stakeholders at a glance.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your plant layout, branding, scale and display case
settings.s1_body: Process plants are hard to picture from drawings alone. This biogas-plant model lays the whole facility out in miniature - digester tanks, pipework, walkways and support structures - all to scale, so engineers, clients and investors can read the layout instantly. Built from your plant drawings and finished on a presentation base with a protective case, it is the centrepiece for boardrooms, exhibitions and project pitches.
settings.case_heading: A Process Plant You Can Point At
settings.case_body: Commissioned for CleanEdge Resource for their WETEX Exhibition. For presenting a biogas facility to stakeholders, this model turned a technical process into something everyone in the room could follow - used in investor meetings, exhibitions and project reviews to explain the plant in seconds.
settings.case_quote: It made our process instantly clear to non-technical investors. Far better than slides.
settings.prov_p: A physical process model communicates scale, layout and flow in a way that flat diagrams cannot - which is why engineering and energy firms still rely on them to win confidence and approvals.
